# A Biblioteca de Arte

> Catálogo pesquisável de arte: conceitos, técnicas, materiais, movimentos artísticos, artistas, curadores, críticos, influenciadores, grupos, museus, bienais, redes sociais, cursos e livros.

Biblioteca temática da BiblioVerse (The Art Library), com curadoria humana. Página: https://biblioverse.org/art/ · 395 itens · atualizada em 2026-11-14.
Legenda: ★ destaque da curadoria · 🪦 pessoa falecida, banda desfeita ou serviço encerrado.

## Livros

### História e teoria da arte

- [Ernst Gombrich - A História da Arte](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=Gombrich+The+Story+of+Art) ★
- [John Berger - Modos de Ver](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=John+Berger+Ways+of+Seeing) ★
- [Giorgio Vasari - Vidas dos Artistas](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=Vasari+Lives+of+the+Artists)
- [Wassily Kandinsky - Do Espiritual na Arte](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=Kandinsky+Concerning+the+Spiritual+in+Art)
- [Rudolf Arnheim - Arte e Percepção Visual](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=Rudolf+Arnheim+Art+and+Visual+Perception)
- [Will Gompertz - Isso é Arte?](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=Will+Gompertz+What+Are+You+Looking+At)
- [Victoria Finlay - Color: A Natural History of the Palette](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=Victoria+Finlay+Color+A+Natural+History)

### Técnica e criatividade

- [Betty Edwards - Desenhando com o Lado Direito do Cérebro](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=Betty+Edwards+Drawing+on+the+Right+Side+of+the+Brain) ★
- [Johannes Itten - A Arte da Cor](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=Johannes+Itten+The+Art+of+Color)
- [Josef Albers - A Interação da Cor](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=Josef+Albers+Interaction+of+Color)
- [James Gurney - Color and Light](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=James+Gurney+Color+and+Light)
- [Andrew Loomis - Figure Drawing for All It's Worth](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=Andrew+Loomis+Figure+Drawing+for+All+It%27s+Worth)
- [Julia Cameron - O Caminho do Artista](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=Julia+Cameron+The+Artist%27s+Way)
- [Austin Kleon - Roube Como um Artista](https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=Austin+Kleon+Steal+Like+an+Artist)
